copy: Hi Drew, I lead go-to-market at a company building workflow automation for analytics teams, and I have been following Kestrel Analytics since your launch. Most teams we work with tell us that the gap between dashboards and decisions is where momentum dies, and that the tooling around it was built for engineers, not for the operators who actually need answers. We help analytics teams shorten that gap without adding another platform to maintain, and we do it in a way that respects the governance work you have already put in. I would love to share what we have learned from peers running similar stacks, and to hear whether any of it lines up with what you are building next. Would you be open to a brief conversation next week? I promise to keep it short and useful, and to follow up with notes either way. Thanks for the work you are doing.
